fusions.name: Drilled Lash
fusions.desc: Your tongue snaps at one enemy up to 7 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach, with a 30% chance to leave it [Stalled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Perfected Form
fusions.desc: You leap to a target up to 6 tiles away and land on it, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Again, From the Top
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and hops you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Stuck the Landing
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover raises your critical hit chance by 15% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
